This service uses the dedicated credential from DeepSeek Harness sign-in.

DeepSeek Harness sign-in opens the official DeepSeek Platform in the browser. Lyra Code exchanges the authorization code with a device identifier and stores the resulting dedicated credential securely on this device, outside backups. Lyra Code uses this credential to read profile and wallet details and to send selected model requests to DeepSeek. If you enable the low balance alert, Lyra Code checks the recharge wallet periodically and may post an Android notification. DeepSeek handles service requests under its own terms and privacy policy.
